notes: height_above_center_m=0.15 and pitch_down_deg=12.0 are the mount values the user confirmed by direct visual inspection of the physical camera and display, not synthetic demo values.

forward_offset_m=0.0 is an explicit placeholder for recorded-video validation runs, matching the display plane. If the real lens center sits in front of the display plane, measure it and replace this value.

camera (camera_matrix / distortion_coefficients) is still the same placeholder as config/hardware_profile.demo.json; replace it with the actual tagcal calibration.json intrinsics before/at recording time.
display (pixel_width/pixel_height/width_m/height_m) is also inherited from the demo profile and unconfirmed; verify the physical panel model and size before relying on absolute scale.
config/hardware_profile.demo.json (the artificial 20 cm / 10 deg demo values) is intentionally left unchanged by this profile.
